title: Evidence register row
description: A registered finding from a named source, or a registered evidence gap (evidence_status unknown, finding states the open question) (ontology: Evidence, prefix EVD). One CSV row is one JSON object keyed by column header; an empty cell means 'not yet known' and is omitted from the object, so 'required' means the cell must be filled. List-valued cells hold IDs separated by ';' with no spaces. Required: evidence_id, source_type, source_reference and collected_at (provenance: what, where from and when, which freshness review depends on), finding (the content or the open question) and evidence_status. journey_id and node_id scope the finding when it is specific; population, sample and limitations may be unknown for secondary sources.
